case_name: Prabhat Chandra Das vs Union Of India
author: Uday Umesh Lalit

paragraphs.text:
INHERENT JURISDICTION

 REVIEW PETITION (CIVIL) D. NO. 527 OF 2021

 SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.8826 OF 2018

 SHRI PRABHAT CHANDRA DAS …Petitioner

 Versus

 UNION OF INDIA & ORS. …Respondents

 O R D E R
There is delay of 987 days in preferring the instant Review Petition.
The Special Leave Petition was dismissed on the ground of inordinate delay

 of 1213 days in filing the Special Leave Petition.

Review Petition is dismissed on the ground of delay.
…………………………J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]

 …………………………J.
 [L. Nageswara Rao]
 New Delhi;
November 30, 2021.
